title: Book Club Attendance Book Mix
dataSources: Club attendance (`club:attendance`), running-club sessions (`runningclub:session`), maker-space visits (`makerspace:visit`), book-club meetings (`bookclub:meeting`), community events (`community:event`).
app: Book-club attendance, running-club miles, maker-space visits, and general social-club participation logs streamed to Splunk HEC via forms, check-ins, and calendar exports.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=bookclub:meeting
| stats count as events sum(pages_read) as total_metric by book_title

description: Shows how book club attendance is split across different book buckets.
value: Mix analysis makes it easy to see whether the activity is diverse and healthy or concentrated in one stale format.
implementation: Use stable group labels like club type, route, venue, or meeting format to keep the trend comparable over time.
visualization: Bar chart of events and total pages read by book.
grandmaExplanation: It spots what kinds of book club attendance you do most often.
